semantics: EXPECTED_RED is a baseline expectation, never a passing status. If reproduced, actual_status remains FAIL and expected_red_observed=true. If fixed, actual_status is PASS and expected_red_observed=false.

items.title: Cross-request supplier bill duplicate guard is not proven
items.baseline_evidence: The controlled Xero draft path keys local idempotency by tenant, request_id, and payload hash. A separate request_id with the same source, supplier, and supplier invoice reference requires an independent business-duplicate guard.
items.risk: Two DRAFT bills can be created for one business document if the caller changes request_id.
items.clear_when: A deterministic test proves that different request IDs for the same tenant, source evidence, supplier, and supplier document cannot produce more than one provider record.
items.prohibited_claim: Do not claim duplicate-safe supplier bill intake from same-request replay alone.

items.title: Conversation confirmation is Agent-asserted, not Host-signed
items.baseline_evidence: The create tool accepts the literal CONFIRMED_FOR_DRAFT supplied by the Agent; the MCP cannot independently verify the user turn or proposal version.
items.risk: A compromised or mistaken Agent can assert confirmation that the Host did not attest.
items.clear_when: The Host issues a short-lived signed confirmation receipt bound to workspace, user, conversation turn, proposal hash, and intended DRAFT action, and the MCP verifies it.
items.prohibited_claim: Do not call the current confirmation path production-grade approval.

items.title: Material source hash is not a trusted Host receipt
items.baseline_evidence: An Agent-supplied hash is unverified and a server fingerprint covers extracted fields, not the original Work file.
items.risk: The audit trail cannot prove which immutable user file produced the extraction.
items.clear_when: The Host signs a receipt over workspace, user, file ID, version, server-computed digest, MIME, and expiry, and the MCP verifies it before prepare and create.
items.prohibited_claim: Do not call source_sha256 end-to-end file provenance.

items.title: Shared Personal POC OAuth does not prove multi-user isolation
items.baseline_evidence: Several logical Agents may reuse one saved Personal POC connection and the same Xero organisation.
items.risk: A multi-Agent pass can be mistaken for workspace, user, customer, or tenant isolation.
items.clear_when: Two independent users with separately attested identities and Xero connections prove deny-by-default cross-binding access and independent revoke/reconnect behavior.
items.prohibited_claim: Do not infer multi-user or multi-customer isolation from multiple Agents sharing one OAuth binding.

items.title: Trial Balance response has no harness-proven transport, source-inspection, or visited-node bound
items.baseline_evidence: The Trial Balance tool returns provider report data and needs a pressure test that independently measures model text and the complete CallToolResult, bounds source inspection and returned visited JSON nodes, and proves explicit truncation semantics.
items.risk: Large reports can overflow the Agent context or make completeness ambiguous.
items.clear_when: A deterministic pressure test independently proves the content-only model-text and complete CallToolResult limits, source-inspection and returned visited JSON-node limits, plus explicit truncation and Provider-completeness metadata.
items.prohibited_claim: Do not call a returned Trial Balance complete unless its bound and completeness evidence are explicit.

items.title: Draft result lacks a guaranteed Xero deep link and MCP audit call identifier
items.baseline_evidence: The controlled create result exposes the record ID and local review URL; a provider deep link and immutable tool-call audit ID are not required by the current result contract.
items.risk: Human follow-up and audit correlation require extra lookup.
items.clear_when: The result contract returns a verified provider deep link and immutable audit event ID without exposing secrets.
items.prohibited_claim: Do not describe the local review URL as a Xero record link.

items.title: Supplier bill Tracking categories are not preserved by the current tool contract
items.baseline_evidence: The prepare and create schemas model line description, quantity, unit amount, account code, and tax type but no Xero Tracking category or option.
items.risk: An accountant cannot preserve department, region, project, or other Xero tracking dimensions when preparing the DRAFT.
items.clear_when: Prepare, create, provider write, idempotency hash, and exact readback all validate and preserve supported Xero Tracking category and option identifiers.
items.prohibited_claim: Do not claim full supplier-bill coding coverage while Tracking is absent.

items.title: Package, MCP serverInfo, health, and readiness versions are inconsistent
items.baseline_evidence: The package version and hard-coded MCP/HTTP response versions must be compared at runtime rather than reported independently.
items.risk: Deployment and test evidence can be attributed to the wrong build.
items.clear_when: One version source produces identical package, MCP initialize, health, and readiness values, verified by a deterministic test.
items.prohibited_claim: Do not identify a tested or deployed build from only one of the inconsistent version fields.
